name: Namida-iro no Kiseki
source: The protagonist just bid eternal farewell to her most precious person. However, he came back as a ghost and appeared in front of her. She can enjoy his company until his unfullfilled desires are granted... What will happen to them from now on?
translation: 主人公刚刚和最珍贵的人永远告别。然而，他以幽灵之身回到她面前。只要帮助他实现未完成的愿望，她就能享受与他相伴的时光……从今以后，两人会发生什么？
